title: Call Reach by Frequency
description: Global/core iDoXs report showing doctor reach by frequency, modeled after legacy rptCallReachPerFrequency.php.

source.sql: with doctor_reach as (select i.[MONTH] as period_code, i.[YEAR] as fiscal_year, i.MD_ID, ltrim(rtrim(cast(i.TERRITORY_ID as varchar(128)))) as territory_id, i.FREQUENCY as frequency, count(i.VISIT_DATE) as visited, max(pi.DISTRICT_ID) as district_id, max(pi.PSR_ID) as psr_id from [dbo].[ITINERARY] i join [dbo].[PSR_ITINERARY] pi on i.TERRITORY_ID = pi.TERRITORY_ID and i.ITINERARY_DATE = pi.ITINERARY_DATE where i.[YEAR] = @fiscalYear and ((@reportType = 'Cycle' and i.[MONTH] = @periodCode) or (@reportType <> 'Cycle' and i.[MONTH] <= @periodCode)) {{territoryPredicate:i.TERRITORY_ID}} group by i.[MONTH], i.[YEAR], i.MD_ID, i.TERRITORY_ID, i.FREQUENCY) select top 5000 district_id, territory_id, nullif(ltrim(rtrim(concat('(', territory_id, ') ', isnull(p.LAST_NAME, ''), ', ', isnull(p.FIRST_NAME, '')))), '(),') as territory_name, concat(cast(isnull(frequency, 0) as varchar(32)), 'x') as frequency, count_big(*) as doctor_count, sum(case when visited = 0 then 0 else 1 end) as visited, cast(case when count_big(*) = 0 then null else (sum(case when visited = 0 then 0 else 1 end) * 100.0 / count_big(*)) end as decimal(18,2)) as percentage from doctor_reach dr left join [dbo].[PSR] p on p.PSR_ID = dr.psr_id where isnull(p.TERRITORY_ID, '') not in ('RRICT') group by district_id, territory_id, nullif(ltrim(rtrim(concat('(', territory_id, ') ', isnull(p.LAST_NAME, ''), ', ', isnull(p.FIRST_NAME, '')))), '(),'), frequency order by district_id, territory_id, frequency
